zh: 神经传导与肌电图机制模拟器。所有波形都由模型实时生成，而不是预先画好的图片。先看记录原理：同一个动作电位，电极位置不同，记录到的波形也不同；按惯例，负相向上。
en: The NCS and EMG mechanism simulator. Every waveform is generated by the model in real time, not switched between pre-drawn pictures. We start with recording basics: one action potential, different electrode positions, different waveforms. By convention, negative is up.

zh: 正常运动神经传导。刺激使轴突同步兴奋，冲动沿神经下行，经过神经肌肉接头激活肌纤维，所有肌纤维电位叠加，形成复合肌肉动作电位。
en: A normal motor nerve conduction study. The stimulus excites the axons together; the impulse travels down the nerve, crosses the neuromuscular junction and activates the muscle fibres. All the fibre potentials sum into the compound muscle action potential.

zh: 离断百分之六十的运动轴突。参与反应的轴突变少，各个刺激点的波幅都下降；但最快的纤维依然完好，所以传导速度几乎不变。
en: Now sixty percent of the motor axons are cut. Fewer axons contribute, so the amplitude falls at every stimulation site; but the fastest fibres are still intact, so conduction velocity barely changes.

zh: 换成前臂的脱髓鞘性传导阻滞。腕部刺激在病灶远端，反应正常；肘部刺激跨过病灶，面积下降超过一半。
en: Switch to a demyelinating conduction block in the forearm. Stimulating at the wrist, distal to the lesion, is normal; stimulating at the elbow crosses the lesion and the area falls by more than half.

zh: 去掉阻滞，只保留轴突之间的减速差异。没有任何轴突被阻滞，但到达时间被拉开，波形增宽、峰值下降，其中一部分来自正负相位的相互抵消。
en: Remove the block and keep only the variation in slowing between axons. No axon is blocked, yet the arrivals are spread out, so the response broadens and its peak falls, partly through cancellation of positive and negative phases.

zh: 针极肌电图。一个运动单位的肌纤维与其他单位的纤维交错分布；针尖附近的少数纤维决定了运动单位电位的波幅。
en: Needle EMG. The fibres of one motor unit are intermingled with the fibres of other units, and the few fibres nearest the needle tip set the amplitude of the motor unit potential.

zh: 肌病时，每个运动单位丢失了约一半肌纤维。运动单位的数量没有变，但每个单位的力变小，于是产生同样的力需要募集更多单位，这就是早募集。
en: In myopathy each unit has lost about half of its fibres. The number of units is unchanged, but each one produces less force, so more units must be recruited for the same force. That is early recruitment.

zh: 同一块肌肉，轴突丢失一年之后。存活的轴突发出侧支芽枝，接管了邻近的失神经纤维，运动单位电位变得又大又长；但单位数量没有恢复，募集仍然减少。
en: The same muscle one year after axonal loss. Surviving axons have sprouted and adopted the neighbouring denervated fibres, so the motor unit potentials are large and long; but the number of units has not recovered and recruitment is still reduced.

zh: 自发电位实验室。纤颤电位来自单根去神经的肌纤维：动作电位从远处传来、经过针尖、再离开，形成起始正相的短小棘波，放电非常规则。
en: The spontaneous activity lab. A fibrillation potential comes from a single denervated muscle fibre: the action potential approaches the tip, passes under it and leaves, giving a brief spike with an initial positive phase and a very regular firing pattern.

zh: 肌强直放电由同样的单纤维产生，单个电位的形态可以完全一样。区别在于放电方式，频率和波幅渐增渐减。
en: A myotonic discharge comes from the same single fibre, and the individual potential can look identical. What separates them is the firing pattern: the rate and amplitude wax and wane.

zh: 病程模块把疾病时钟和毫秒时钟分开。伤后十二小时，远端刺激完全正常，只有跨病灶刺激下降。
en: The time course module keeps the disease clock separate from the millisecond clock. Twelve hours after the injury, distal stimulation is entirely normal and only stimulation across the lesion is reduced.

zh: 到第十天，沃勒变性完成，远端的运动和感觉反应也降下来了。
en: By day ten, Wallerian degeneration is complete and the distal motor and sensory responses have fallen too.

zh: 第二十一天，纤颤电位出现。它出现的早晚取决于病灶到肌肉的距离，而不是固定的天数。
en: On day twenty-one, fibrillation potentials appear. When they appear depends on the length of nerve between the lesion and the muscle, not on a fixed number of days.

zh: 一年之后，再支配让运动单位电位增大，复合电位部分恢复，纤颤减少。同一个病灶，不同时间，结论完全不同。
en: One year later, reinnervation has enlarged the motor unit potentials, the compound response has partly recovered and the fibrillations are fewer. The same lesion at a different time gives a very different study.

zh: 定位诊断。C8 神经根病的病灶位于后根神经节近端，感觉神经元的胞体和周围突完好，所以感觉电位保留；而 C8 肌节的肌肉跨正中、尺、桡多条神经受累。
en: Localization. A C8 radiculopathy sits proximal to the dorsal root ganglion, so the sensory cell bodies and their peripheral axons are intact and the sensory potentials are preserved, while C8 muscles are involved across the median, ulnar and radial nerves.

zh: 把病灶移到臂丛下干，也就是神经节远端。感觉轴突与胞体断开，尺神经和前臂内侧皮神经的感觉电位下降，椎旁肌则恢复正常。
en: Move the lesion to the lower trunk of the brachial plexus, distal to the ganglion. Now the sensory axons are cut off from their cell bodies, the ulnar and medial antebrachial cutaneous responses fall, and the paraspinals become normal.

zh: 神经肌肉接头。重症肌无力时受体减少，安全系数下降。三赫兹重复刺激让可释放的递质逐次减少，安全系数最低的肌纤维先失败，于是出现递减。
en: The neuromuscular junction. In myasthenia gravis there are fewer receptors and the safety factor is reduced. Three hertz repetitive stimulation depletes the readily available transmitter, the fibres with the lowest safety factor fail first, and a decrement appears.

zh: F 波。超强刺激产生的逆向冲动到达前角细胞，只有百分之一到五的运动神经元回返放电，而且每次都是不同的一组，所以 F 波很小、形态多变。整个过程没有突触，它不是反射。
en: F waves. The antidromic volley from a supramaximal stimulus reaches the anterior horn cells, where only one to five percent of motor neurons backfire, and a different set each time, so F waves are small and variable. There is no synapse: it is not a reflex.

zh: 全部波形都由模型实时生成并测量。
en: Every waveform here is generated and measured by the model.
